narrative.overview: Preserve the established sage and ink identity: restrained green text, warm pale backgrounds, white panels and explicit numeric hierarchy. This is a working dashboard; a compact introduction brings the national figures and navigation into view quickly.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet surfaces and clear section divisions.
Party colours reserved for labelled election data.
Visible demonstration status and discoverable assumptions.
Native controls with keyboard and touch access.

rules.name: The Party Neutrality Rule
rules.body: Interface actions use the sage and ink palette. Party colours identify data; party names and numerical values carry the same information without colour.

dos: Do preserve the sage and ink palette and compact dashboard hierarchy.
Do pair colour with labels, values and visible selected states.
Do support touch, keyboard, visible focus and reduced motion.
Do label synthetic figures, candidates and scenarios as fictional or hypothetical.
donts: Don't imply that approximate markers are electorate boundaries.
Don't describe demo leaders as winners, scenarios as forecasts, or user groupings as agreements.
Don't invent live reporting progress, timestamps, polls or predictive certainty.
